# Fixtures

- `logs/real-*`: captured from real builds (`npx expo export`, `./gradlew`, `pod install`, `xcodebuild`) of a project created with `create-expo-app` (Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86, Gradle 9.3.1, AGP 8.12, Xcode 26.6). The xcodebuild log keeps only the last 1,200 lines of the 53,000-line original. Captured on 2026-10-14. Failures were introduced deliberately. Paths are anonymized to `/Users/dev`. ANSI color codes are kept on purpose to exercise normalization.
- `logs/real-rn08*`, `logs/real-xcode26-linker-*`, `logs/real-cocoapods-no-such-version.log`, `logs/real-gradle93-jvm-maxpermsize.log`, `logs/real-logcat-*`, `logs/real-cocoapods-install-success.log`: captured on 2026-10-15 from two React Native CLI apps (React Native 0.86.2 with Gradle 9.3.1 / AGP 8.12, and 0.87.0 with Gradle 9.4.1 / AGP 9.2.1), Xcode 26.6, CocoaPods 1.16.2, OpenJDK 17.0.20, and an Android 14 emulator. Failures were introduced through Gradle init scripts, build-setting overrides, or edited copies of the apps. App names and paths are anonymized to `MyApp` and `/Users/dev`. The logcat files are slices (581 and 576 lines) that keep the surrounding system noise on purpose.
- `logs/real-rn087-gradle-cxx-minsdk.log`, `logs/real-expo58-gradle-cxx-minsdk.log`, `logs/real-logcat-bridgeless-js-abort.log`: captured on 2026-10-19 from a React Native CLI app (React Native 0.87.0, Gradle 9.4.1, AGP 9.2.1) and an Expo SDK 58 app (React Native 0.88.0), OpenJDK 17.0.20, and an Android 14 emulator. The minSdk failures come from lowering minSdkVersion to 23 (in android/build.gradle, and through expo-build-properties). The logcat is from a release build that throws at startup. Paths and package names are anonymized to `/Users/dev/MyApp` and `com.myapp`. The logcat keeps all 648 lines, including other threads of the app and system noise. `logs/real-expo58-prebuild-*` and `logs/real-expo58-metro-unresolved-package.log` come from the same Expo app: `expo prebuild` with a config plugin that isn't installed, with a local plugin file that doesn't exist, and with an app.config.js that throws, and `expo export` importing a package that isn't installed.
- `logs/real-rn087-gradle-builtin-kotlin.log`, `logs/real-rn087-gradle-newdsl-kotlin.log`, `logs/real-rn087-ios-unnamespaced-header.log`, `logs/real-rn087-logcat-cleartext-blocked.log`: captured on 2026-10-20 from the same React Native 0.87.0 CLI app (Gradle 9.4.1, AGP 9.2.1, Xcode 26.6, CocoaPods 1.16.2, OpenJDK 17.0.20, Android 14 emulator). The Gradle logs come from removing `android.builtInKotlin=false` and `android.newDsl=false` (both, and only `newDsl`) from gradle.properties. The iOS log comes from a clean simulator build with a local pod in `node_modules/react-native-bad-import` that imports `"RCTBridge.h"` and `<RCTBridge.h>` (a third file with `<React/RCTBridge.h>` compiled); it keeps two slices of the 9,725-line original: lines 7,618–7,630 (ReactNativeHeaders) and 9,040 to the end. The logcat comes from a release build that fetches `http://10.0.2.2:8099` at startup while a server was listening there; the same build with `android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"` got HTTP 200. Paths and names are anonymized to `/Users/dev/MyApp`, `MyApp`, and `com.myapp`.
- `logs/android-windows-ninja-long-path.log`: the Gradle failure posted in expo/expo#36274 (Windows 11, Expo SDK 52, React Native 0.76), with its path typo normalized and standard Gradle framing lines added.
- `logs/*` (others): synthetic logs that reproduce the documented or observed format of each error. Tokens in `secrets.log` are fake. The AWS key is AWS's documented example.
- `projects/*`: minimal project layouts. `node_modules` folders inside fixtures contain only `package.json` stubs (and `bundledNativeModules.json` for Expo).

Every fixture referenced by a rule's `meta.fixtures` must exist (enforced by `tests/unit/rules-metadata.test.ts`).
